'''Largess cakes''' were a kind of small [[Cake/Legends|cake]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]].<ref name="TFJP" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The scene in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]" in which [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] has just eaten the Largess [[Cake/Legends|cakes]] takes place concurrently to {{Film|VI}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], head [[Chef/Legends|chef]] at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], gave a pair of the pastries to the Ortolan [[Music/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]].<ref name="TFJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Largess cakes were mentioned in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," a short story written by [[John Gregory Betancourt]] and published in the ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' story collection in [[1995]].<ref name="TFJP" />
